text:
raj (support): ACME paging — customers hitting intermittent 502/504s on hosted embeddings since ~09:20 PST. They say it started right after a tenant token rotation. sample request attached.

emma (SRE): can you paste a sample request and a trace id? is this guest traffic or tenant-specific?

raj (support): guest keys for this tenant, batch size ~128 embeddings calls. trace id: trace-0a1b2c3d. curl: `curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer guest_XXXX" "https://api.redwood/v1/embeddings" -d '{"model":"open-embed-1","input":[...128 items...]}'`

sofia (runtime): thanks — from past incidents, large parallel embed batches + auth rotate can exhaust upstream keepalive pools. any envoy/ingress logs?

raj (support): pasted minimal envoy lines from customer logs: `upstream_reset_before_response{protocol:HTTP2, reason:PAUSE, upstream_host:10.3.5.12:443} -> 502` and `HTTP/2 stream closed with error: rst_stream`

emma (SRE): schedule: likely a conn pool drain/unhealthy upstream during rotation. @mike can you check ingress upstream connection count & RST rate around 1766504300-1766504600?

mike (infra): running quick check: `kubectl -n edge logs svc/ingress-proxy --since=1h | grep -E "rst_stream|connection refused|upstream_reset" | wc -l` -> 134 hits in the window. `envoy_admin?stats` shows h2.stream_resets: 118 and upstream_cx_tx_reset: 72.

oncall-bot: incident.alert: high edge upstream resets (svc/ingress-proxy) — rate 2.1/min over baseline.

sofia (runtime): that aligns. hypothesis: token rotation triggered short auth-proxy restarts which caused upstreams to temporarily reject/close sockets; batch concurrency amplified client-side fanout causing connection-window exhaustion -> 502s.

raj (support): customer repro steps: 1) rotate guest token for tenant 123, 2) send concurrent embedding batches (50 clients * 128 items), 3) observe 502s ~10-30s after rotation.

emma (SRE): immediate mitigation: advise customer to throttle concurrency during rotation OR use smaller batch sizes. ops mitigation options: extend auth proxy graceful window during rotation, bump keepalive pool size, or enable fallback routing to a warmed dedicated auth-cache node.

mike (infra): quick patch we can try: bump `envoy.h2.max_concurrent_streams` and increase upstream keepalive pool config on the auth-proxy fleet. rolling patch in progress -> deploy-bot starting canary.

deploy-bot: canary start: ingress-proxy-v2 -> 3 pods (canary) with updated keepalive/streams at 1766504560.

sofia (runtime): long-term: add client-side backoff guidance in docs for token rotations, and add a guard in auth rotation job to drain active connections rather than hard replace. I'll open an RFC.

raj (support): I've informed the customer and recommended temporary throttling + smaller batches. asked for new traces after canary finishes.

emma (SRE): monitor: watch envoy h2.stream_resets and upstream_cx_tx_reset, and hosted-api 502 rate. if canary shows improvement, promote patch and schedule auth-rotation playbook update.

mike (infra): canary shows 90% drop in resets vs baseline in first 8m after deploy. promoting.

raj (support): customer confirmed a drop in 502s after we asked them to reduce parallelism; will validate again post-promo. :thumbsup:

sofia (runtime): filing follow-ups: RFC for rotation drain, docs snippet for batch guidance, and test harness to simulate rotation+fanout.

emma (SRE): closing loop: set postmortem if recurrence. for now mark as mitigated.

raj (support): thanks everyone — I’ll keep thread updated with any regression.
